source: NMMS MAT daily practice papers with answers from the Office of the Deputy Director of Public Instruction, Bengaluru North district (sources/question-papers/model/ka-bengaluru-north-daily-mat.pdf). Not a real exam paper. Each printed section is numbered from Q1; a section can feed more than one chapter, so every question names its own. The paper's answer key is checked by tools/check_model.ts.

sections.title: Number Series
sections.directions: Complete the following number series by choosing the correct number from the given choices.

sections.title: Letter Series

sections.directions: Identify the incorrect number in the given number sequence.

sections.title: Odd one number
sections.directions: In each of the following questions, 4 sets of numbers / pairs of numbers are given. 3 of these have some kind of relationship. Only one is different. Identify the different one.

sections.title: Letters: Odd one
